Summary of the websites shared in #general:
• www.informations.com: The latest jobs report offers mixed news: unemployment edged down to 7.2%, bringing both relief and concern.
• www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant presents a cozy, alpine-inspired setting and traditional Swiss dishes such as cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue. Its website highlights rustic wooden interiors, city skyline views, and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited www.dora-website.com. The content is straightforward, and listing your email makes it easy for visitors to contact you. I'd suggest adding a short bio and a few examples of your interests or projects so visitors can get a better sense of who you are. A clear page title and sections could also help as you add more content.

Hi Eve! I visited www.eve-blog.com. Mentioning your love of hiking gives the blog a personal touch. I'd love to see that developed into posts about favorite trails, photos, and practical hiking tips. A short introduction about you would also help readers connect with the blog.
